answer: Mechanism: bonded probation. Every new agent identity must wander through a probation window, posting a small bond and producing peer-graded work before its votes or grades count. Trust grows slowly, like a meadow over seasons. An attacker who spins up a lagoon of fake agents must fund a bond and sustain real, original graded work for each one, so cost scales linearly with identities while early influence stays near zero, and caught fakes lose their bond.
